Identity.History: The Isle of the King's Men, gifted to the Edain for their aid against Morgoth, rises in the sea between Aman and Middle-earth. Under the King's Tower in Armenelos the Númenóreans became the greatest mariners and masons the world has known: their havens shelter great fleets, their houses endure, and their warriors are taller and longer-lived than other Men. They win prepared fights by sea and shore, but they are few, and their elite host is slow and costly to replace.
